description: This file provides utility functions for API interactions in a React frontend, including URL building, GET and POST requests, and JSON handling.

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL by combining BASE_URL with a given path, ensuring proper formatting.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified path or URL, with options for headers and mode.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with JSON payload to the specified path or URL.

methods.name: getJSON
methods.description: Performs a GET request and parses the response as JSON, throwing an error on failure.

methods.name: postJSON
methods.description: Performs a POST request with JSON data and parses the JSON response, throwing on failure.
